stops.name: Das Biosphärenreservat „Niedersächsische Elbtalaue“
stops.detail: The biosphere reserve “Niedersächsische Elbtalaue” is a biosphere reserve in the German federal state of Lower Saxony, which comprises the floodplain landscape of the Elbe in its lower middle course. The Mittelelbe Biosphere Reserve connects to the Elbtalaue and since 1997 is also part of the UNESCO-recognized Biosphere Reserve River Landscape Elbe.
